body.text: Public API: Sealer::new([u8;32]), seal(&[u8])->(String,String), open(&str,&str)->Result<Vec<u8>,AegisError>; BrokerState::new(Arc<dyn BrokerStore>, Sealer, token), public store/sealer/broker_token/stripe_base_url/jev_base_url/llm_base_url/http fields, with_upstreams(stripe,jev,llm), issue_fake_key(subject,agent_id,provider,ttl_secs)->Result<IssuedFakeKey,...>. MemoryStore::new/default; StoredSecret {meta: SecretMeta, nonce, ciphertext}; StoredFakeKey {sha256_hex, info: FakeKeyInfo}; UsageRow {fake_key_hash,subject,agent_id,provider,path,ok,ts}. Router has admin endpoints and proxy routes. Key generation is random 24 alnum; tests should derive stored hash from returned issued key. Fake key prefix is first 20 chars. No deterministic suffix.
